title: Field settings: validation errors and the report wording tooltip
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A template with a checkbox field (response labels) and a per-axle field (measurement rows). Seed it: Settings - Service > Inspection Templates > New template (or Edit), use Add field to add the fields, then Save.
custom_steps:
1. Clear a response label and confirm an error shows on the row itself and blocks publishing, while still allowing a draft to be saved.
2. Clear a measurement row name and confirm the same behaviour, with the error on the row so the author sees which one is at fault.
3. Confirm validation rules are explained on demand rather than as permanent panel text.
4. Open the response-options tooltip and confirm it says the labels are the author's to edit but the customer report always uses the standard wording, and that what the report prints does not change.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • An empty response label shows an error on the row itself and blocks publishing, while still allowing the author to save a draft.
  • An empty measurement row name behaves the same way, with the error on the row so the author can see which row is at fault.
  • Validation rules are explained on demand rather than as permanent text on the panel.
  • A tooltip on the response options explains that the labels are the author's to edit but the customer report always uses the standard wording; what the report prints does not change.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9110 (S12 — Template builder authoring); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S12; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R12: “An empty response label will show an error on the row itself and will block publishing, while still allowing the author to save a draft”
  • S12-R13: “An empty measurement row name will behave the same way, with the error on the row, so the author can see which row is at fault”
  • S12-R14: “Validation rules will be explained on demand rather than as permanent text on the panel”
  • S12-R15: “The author will be told on demand — a tooltip on the response options — that the labels are theirs to edit but that the customer report always uses the standard wording, so reports stay comparable. What the report prints does not change; only where the author is told”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
